configuration.isolationAudit: Original frozen v541 PCM, beatmaps and old BPM predictions already exist for these songs; they were not used in v559-v572 development inference, candidate evaluation or annotation. Do not claim the audio was never decoded

oldTargetPipeline.source: Exact v548 multiband/top2/DP pipeline and v557 full/high candidate selection logic
oldTargetPipeline.globalDelay: stable hits excluding first/last 1000 ms; delay -60..60 step 0.25 ms
oldTargetPipeline.phase: top2 aggregate, dynamic programming, actual cross-fit odd/even phases; old target = hit time + globalDelay + opposite-fold phase
oldTargetPipeline.fullPeaks: production onsetEnvelope, normalization threshold 0.02, 5 ms suppression radius, parabolic interpolation and 3*WIN/4 bias

objectSelection.rule: Exact v557: up to 10 per stratum, rare strata first, deficits assigned one at a time to largest remaining pool; hash order sha256(v557:sample-id:hit-time); at least 200 ms spacing
objectSelection.weights: stratum population / actually selected objects in that stratum

annotation.method: Provisional visual blind labels on original-time waveform and clip-normalized spectral envelope; no algorithm onset, corrected target or phase shown
annotation.audioClip: reference -500 ms to +500 ms, original channels and time axis
annotation.plot: 1 s context plus +/-80 ms waveform/envelope with 5 ms minor ticks
annotation.actualOnsetMs: Integer original-audio milliseconds for clear/approximate; null for no_clear_onset
annotation.noClearPolicy: Do not force an onset when no clear independent onset exists

methods.e5Calibrated: Nearest full peak to old target +/-10 ms, then subtract opposite-fold correction
methods.e13CorrectedTargetRematch: Exact frozen v572: correctedCenter=oldTarget-oppositeFoldCorrection; nearest full peak within correctedCenter +/-10 ms; selected peak is absolute candidate with no second correction

crossfitCalibration.foldRule: Unique hit-object index parity: even index -> odd fold, odd index -> even fold
crossfitCalibration.fitPopulation: Selected clear/approximate objects with an existing old-target full candidate and finite absolute error from the opposite fold of the same song

configuration.primaryMetric: Population-weighted clear+approximate +/-5 ms correct rate over all six songs; missing candidates incorrect

hypotheses.H1: Frozen E13 achieves at least 80% population-weighted clear+approximate +/-5 ms correct rate on the six reserved songs
hypotheses.H2: E13 has positive net fixed weight versus E5 and does not increase no-clear candidate output rate
hypotheses.H3: Selection, labels, opposite-fold calibration, candidates and all metrics can be independently reconstructed without changing any E13 parameter

configuration.resultPolicy: Report success or failure literally; no parameter, sample, label or threshold changes after seeing confirmation metrics. Per-song results are descriptive; the 80% threshold applies to the overall primary metric
